original.target_description: Couture, Lafond, and Tremblay (2008), single empirical experiment: effect of one to four prior occurrences of erroneous responses on the estimated probability of repeating the error in the recurring nine-letter sequence; experimental errors ANOVA, excluding the separately reported correct-response and simulated-data tests.

n.sample_role: Participants contributing pooled occurrences and response opportunities to the error probabilities; the ANOVA analyzes these estimated probabilities, not independent participant-level scores.
n.exclusions: No participant exclusions reported. Analysis considers 16 adjacent-position transpositions and prior occurrences 1–4; number of nonmissing probability cells entering the target ANOVA is not explicitly stated.
n.location: Published p. 528 (PDF p. 5), Example 2; participant recruitment on p. 525 (PDF p. 2), Method—Participants.
n.quote: To estimate response probabilities for each repetition, we divided the … total number of occurrences on the total number of opportu- … nities when combined for all 24 participants.
